review.note: Retracted in M40b: ten weeks in the South Atlantic in 1982 between Argentina and the United Kingdom. The atlas holds no record anywhere in South America outside Brazil, and none of the Argentine dictatorship, so the war's largest consequence — the collapse of the junta and the return to civilian rule in 1983 — is not a record here. There is no Portuguese link at all. It would need the Argentine transition as a record before it had an honest edge.
